entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I'm calling because I need to return a pair of cycling shoes I bought a little while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I got them about six weeks ago.

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order from December 3rd. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the fit. I've tried everything, adjusting the cleats, different socks, but they're just giving me terrible blisters on every ride. I can't wear them anymore.
Oh, that definitely sounds uncomfortable, I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. Let me check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I've reviewed your order. It was delivered 42 days ago, and since our standard apparel and shoes have a 10-day return window, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe. I can cannot offer a refund for you.

That's great news, I'm glad we can get the refund sorted out. Since I did have to deal with the discomfort and the hassle of the return, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I understand your position, but our policy for a standard return is to provide a full refund for the item's value. We don't typically offer additional discounts in these situations. The good news is you'll get all your money back for the shoes.
Okay, I see. How about this then? To save VeloFit the return shipping and restocking fee, what if you just issued a 50% partial credit and I keep the cycling shoes? I could try selling them myself.

That's a creative thought, but our system is set up for full returns to ensure product integrity and a straightforward refund process. The best and only option I can provide is to proceed with the free return for your full refund.
Alright, I had to ask. The full refund sounds good. Let's proceed with that.

Excellent. I have initiated the return. You will receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label and instructions. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
